crossRefs.note: He said, “You cannot see my face, for man may not see me and live.”
“Can you fathom the mystery of God? Or can you probe the limits of the Almighty?
Behold, these are but the outskirts of his ways. How small a whisper do we hear of him! But the thunder of his power…
No one has seen God at any time. The one and only Son, who is in the bosom of the Father, has declared him.
For now we see in a mirror, dimly, but then face to face. Now I know in part, but then I will know fully, even as I was…
He alone has immortality, dwelling in unapproachable light, whom no man has seen, nor can see: to whom be honor and…

translations.web: then I will take away my hand, and you will see my back; but my face shall not be seen.”
translations.bsb: Then I will take My hand away, and you will see My back; but My face must not be seen.”
translations.kjv: And I will take away mine hand, and thou shalt see my back parts: but my face shall not be seen.
translations.asv: and I will take away my hand, and thou shalt see my back; but my face shall not be seen.
